gaps: This bounded pass does not exhaust every organization within the three NPA service regions.
No individual affiliation, protected attribute, membership, health status or personal identity is inferred from organizational discovery.
Follow-on targets remain limited to public organization/project/partner relationships.

classification_rules: Do not infer individual political affiliation from organization proximity, attendance, public role or area-code locality.
Do not label an organization anarchist absent explicit organization-level self-description.
Treat mutual aid, civic education, public health support, social support and community organizing as source descriptions rather than inferred ideology.
Reuse canonical organization identities when already present; an overlay or new NPA is not a new organization.
Treat public organizational contacts only as organization-level evidence and do not enrich private-person data.
Do not infer protected or sensitive attributes of individuals from an organization's public mission, locality, participation or services.

findings.notes: Grassroots Westmoreland has current first-party Westmoreland County mutual-aid/community-care and civic-education surfaces; no anarchist label or person affiliation is inferred.
Progressive People's Action has a current public organization hub self-describing mutual aid in Pinellas, Florida; no person health or political attributes are inferred.
DITO has a current public organization profile self-describing mutual aid/social support and Carbondale locality within the 618/730 overlay; no person identity or protected attribute is inferred.

data.method: Recomputed the durable shard-B backlog from current main, admitted only current U.S. geographic NPAs, searched the existing corpus before external discovery, preferred current first-party or organization-controlled public sources, and created new organization records only after no canonical identity collision was found.
data.research_question: Which public organizations relevant to the anarchist-violence corpus are discoverable from the next unresolved authoritative shard-B U.S. geographic NPAs 724, 727 and 730?
